<h1 id="jdk下载安装与配置"><code>JDK</code>下载，安装与配置</h1>
<h2 id="下载">下载</h2>
<p>官网地址：<a href="https://www.oracle.com/cn/java/technologies/downloads/archive/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">Java Archive | Oracle 中国</a></p>
<p>网盘地址：<a href="https://pan.baidu.com/s/1pkgQeeqmN3dScRNvQJleeg?pwd=47in" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://pan.baidu.com/s/1pkgQeeqmN3dScRNvQJleeg?pwd=47in</a> 提取码:47in 复制这段内容后打开百度网盘手机App，操作更方便哦</p>
<p>这里地区最后选择其它国家，中国下载页面的版本不全，而且页面描述的和实际下载的版本不一致</p>
<p><img alt="image-20260223112614028" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2747704/202602/2747704-20260223190953262-1210590978.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="image-20260223112807626" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2747704/202602/2747704-20260223191451991-304271925.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h3 id="选择对应的jdk版本">选择对应的<code>jdk</code>版本</h3>
<p><img alt="image-20260223113231990" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2747704/202602/2747704-20260223191630507-1490274650.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h3 id="选择对应的系统">选择对应的系统</h3>
<p><img alt="image-20260223113624187" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2747704/202602/2747704-20260223191712917-1602330960.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h3 id="点击下载">点击下载</h3>
<p><code>.exe</code>：下载后，双击就可以进行安装了（安装简单）</p>
<p><code>.tar.gz、 .tar.Z</code>：下载后，需要解压</p>
<p><img alt="image-20260223120918835" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2747704/202602/2747704-20260223191753232-169795462.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h3 id="创建oracle">创建<code>Oracle</code></h3>
<p>点击下载后，会弹出登录账户框，没有的话可以创建账户</p>
<p><img alt="image-20260222195524099" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2747704/202602/2747704-20260223191836106-1700598564.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>除了邮箱，其余都可以随便填</p>
<p><img alt="image-20260222201208348" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2747704/202602/2747704-20260223191905905-393926681.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="image-20260222201316008" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2747704/202602/2747704-20260223191940226-418980765.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="image-20260223111659516" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2747704/202602/2747704-20260223192008653-1993178271.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>查看电子邮件消息，点击确认</p>
<h2 id="安装">安装</h2>
<h3 id="双击运行exe启动安装程序">双击运行<code>exe</code>，启动安装程序</h3>
<p><img alt="image-20260223122436888" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2747704/202602/2747704-20260223192049208-2030793634.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h3 id="选择下一步">选择下一步</h3>
<p><img alt="image-20260223122530204" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2747704/202602/2747704-20260223192109282-2039436648.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h3 id="注意查看jdk安装地址选择下一步">注意查看<code>jdk</code>安装地址，选择下一步</h3>
<p><img alt="image-20260223122642991" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2747704/202602/2747704-20260223192135542-1544713251.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h3 id="许可证确定">许可证确定</h3>
<p><img alt="image-20260223123313998" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2747704/202602/2747704-20260223192208044-1322104093.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h3 id="java安装"><code>java</code>安装</h3>
<p><img alt="image-20260223123516443" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2747704/202602/2747704-20260223192238253-251406913.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h3 id="安装完成关闭即可">安装完成，关闭即可</h3>
<p><img alt="image-20260223123702235" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2747704/202602/2747704-20260223192304086-43948053.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>查看我们已经安装的<code>jdk</code>版本</p>
<p><img alt="image-20260223124028065" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2747704/202602/2747704-20260223192337452-209724635.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>在我们相对应的<code>jdk</code>版本的<code>bin</code>目录下，确认一下我们安装的<code>jdk</code>版本</p>
<p><img alt="image-20260223124152012" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2747704/202602/2747704-20260223192416757-97502633.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>找到对应的安装目录，输入<code>cmd</code>，回车进入命令行模式，查看<code>jdk</code>的版本信息</p>
<p><img alt="image-20260223124335614" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2747704/202602/2747704-20260223192451282-1343845969.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h2 id="配置">配置</h2>
<h3 id="环境变量">环境变量</h3>
<p>在电脑的任务栏中，搜索“环境变量”</p>
<p><img alt="image-20260223124624215" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2747704/202602/2747704-20260223192533240-1860414256.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>在弹出的系统属性弹出框中，选中高级，再点击环境变量</p>
<p><img alt="image-20260223124719793" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2747704/202602/2747704-20260223192551689-2027069442.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>新增系统变量</p>
<p><img alt="image-20260223125300198" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2747704/202602/2747704-20260223192611288-452530243.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>命令<code>JAVA_HOME</code>，并选择相应版本的安装目录，点击确定</p>
<p><img alt="image-20260223125446542" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2747704/202602/2747704-20260223192631409-1897610713.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>双击<code>Path</code>系统变量</p>
<p><img alt="image-20260223125636228" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2747704/202602/2747704-20260223192702947-552905760.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>选择新增</p>
<p><img alt="image-20260223125707987" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2747704/202602/2747704-20260223192723429-1694089504.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>新建环境变量：<code>%JAVA_HOME%\bin</code>，点击确定</p>
<p><img alt="image-20260223152129097" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2747704/202602/2747704-20260223192741290-1703074087.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>点击确定</p>
<p><img alt="image-20260223152209224" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2747704/202602/2747704-20260223192757727-1135672588.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>点击确定</p>
<p><img alt="image-20260223152241134" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2747704/202602/2747704-20260223192819154-264375575.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>按住<code>Window + R</code>，输入<code>cmd</code>，回车进入命令行模式</p>
<p><img alt="image-20260223152411553" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2747704/202602/2747704-20260223192835547-1463399210.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>查看<code>jdk</code>版本</p>
<p><img alt="image-20260223152502613" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2747704/202602/2747704-20260223192851794-1490220968.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h3 id="android-studio配置"><code>android studio</code>配置</h3>
<p>首先，打开<code>Android studio</code>，点击菜单栏的<code>File</code>，然后选择<code>Settings</code>面板</p>
<p><img alt="image-20260223173511801" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2747704/202602/2747704-20260223192913864-1307143844.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>在<code>Setting</code>窗口中，依次选择<code>Build, Execution, Deployment -&gt; Build Tools -&gt; Gradle</code>。在<code>Gradle</code>设置页面，你可以看到一个<code>Gradle JDK</code>，选中你安装的<code>jdk</code>的所在目录，然后点击<code>OK</code>保存更改，<code>Android Studio</code>就会使用新的<code>JDK</code>进行构建了。</p>
<p><img alt="image-20260223173730420" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2747704/202602/2747704-20260223192932669-778459173.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>点击<code>Sync Now</code>重新构建</p>
<p><img alt="image-20260223180243305" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2747704/202602/2747704-20260223192955311-69587716.png" class="lazyload"></p>
